title: ScoreSaber Beatsaver Buttons
tagline: Chrome extension that adds a one-click install, twitch !bsr, BeatSaver/Beatleader link, and download button to the ScoreSaber leaderboards. 🎮
why: Grabbing a map from a ScoreSaber leaderboard should be one click, not a detour through BeatSaver.

sections.title: How to install it
numbered: You have to use a chromium browser (chrome, brave, edge, opera, ...)
